_comment: Where the harness gets values for endpoint placeholders. Keys are '<segment>/:<param>' for path parameters or '?<name>=' for empty query parameters. Each query must return one text column in a deterministic order; the harness picks from it with a seeded RNG. Queries are read-only.

ecommerce.categories/:slug: SELECT slug FROM "Category" ORDER BY slug
ecommerce.customers/:id: SELECT c.id::text FROM "Customer" c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Order" o WHERE o."customerId" = c.id) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 100
ecommerce.orders/:id: SELECT o.id::text FROM "Order" o JOIN "Customer" c ON c.id = o."customerId" WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM "OrderItem" i WHERE i."orderId" = o.id) >= 3 ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 100
ecommerce.products/:id: SELECT p.id::text FROM "Product" p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Review" r WHERE r."productId" = p.id) ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 100

blog.authors/:id: SELECT a.id::text FROM "Author" a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Post" p WHERE p."authorId" = a.id) ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 100
blog.posts/:slug: SELECT p.slug FROM "Post" p WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "PostTag" t WHERE t."postId" = p.id) ORDER BY p.slug LIMIT 100
blog.tags/:slug: SELECT slug FROM "Tag" ORDER BY slug
blog.?email=: SELECT "authorEmail" FROM "Comment" WHERE "authorEmail" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC, 1 LIMIT 100
